## SAA Webinar Series {#webinars}

The SAA webinar series is an online platform for everyone interested in the development of sequence analysis and related methods in the social sciences. Sessions feature newly published articles as well as work in progress. The series is organised by Emanuela Struffolino and Carla Rowold.

::: {.icon-list}
- []{.bi .bi-calendar3} Approximately **monthly, on Thursdays at 4 PM CET**, lasting 60–75 minutes.
- []{.bi .bi-easel} Two 20-minute presentations on a shared topic, each followed by 5–10 minutes of discussion, plus 15 minutes of general discussion.
- []{.bi .bi-record-circle} Recordings are made only when speakers agree and are available for one month; work-in-progress sessions are not recorded.
:::

## Conferences {#conferences}

### 2026

[]{.bi .bi-geo-alt .ico}**Pre-EPC meeting — "Life Course Dynamics: Insights from Sequence Analysis"**
3 June 2026, Bologna (IT). One-day side meeting before the European Population Conference, organised by Danilo Bolano, Kevin Emery, Carla Rowold, Dolores Sesma Carlos and Emanuela Struffolino. Participation was free of charge; supported by the ERC project WIDOW (G.A. 101117173).

[]{.bi .bi-geo-alt .ico}**SER workshop — "Sequence Analysis: a novel methodology for the analysis of life-course trajectories in social epidemiology"**
23 June 2026, Phoenix (US), at the Society for Epidemiological Research meeting. Instructors: Lucia Pacca, Jilly Hebert and Anusha Vable.

[]{.bi .bi-geo-alt .ico}**Pre-PAA workshop**
6 May 2026, St. Louis (US), run by Tim Liao in collaboration with Ting-Syuan Lin.
